verdict.rationale: Activepieces supports self-hosting and running entirely on your own infrastructure ('Bring your own AI keys, run it on your own infrastructure, and keep the governance your company needs'), which implicitly gives operators control over where data lives and lets them delete it themselves, and audit logs track actions taken. However there is no explicit documentation of data retention policies, configurable retention windows, or built-in deletion/export tooling for flow run data. Missing for 10: explicit retention/TTL settings, data deletion APIs or UI controls, and independent confirmation these work as described.
